design_gotchas.title: EN Pin Abs Max Is Strictly 6.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V or 24 V VIN
design_gotchas.detail: Although VIN handles up to 28 V (30 V abs max), Pin 3 (EN) is rated to only 6.0 V absolute maximum. Float EN to auto-enable via internal pull-up or use a resistive UVLO divider from VIN that keeps VEN safely below 5 V at maximum line surge.

design_gotchas.title: Pin-for-Pin Match With 3 A TPS54331DR — Check 2.3 A Min Switch Current Limit & Compensation Before Downgrading
design_gotchas.detail: TPS54231DR shares the exact SOIC-8 pinout, 570 kHz clock, 0.800 V VREF, and 80 mΩ high-side FET of TPS54331DR, making it a cost-optimized 2 A sibling. However, minimum current limit drops from 3.5 A to 2.3 A, so never swap TPS54231DR onto a > 1.8-2.0 A load without checking inductor peak current.

design_gotchas.title: Non-Synchronous Buck Requires External Schottky Catch Diode & Type-II COMP Network
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike modern synchronous SOT-23-6 bucks (TPS54302DDCR, AP63203WU-7), TPS54231DR requires an external 40 V / 3 A Schottky diode (D1) from GND to PH plus external RC compensation on COMP (Pin 6), limiting 12 V-to-3.3 V efficiency to ~88%.

design_gotchas.title: Non-PowerPAD SOIC-8 (116.3 °C/W) Thermal Budget at 24 V-to-3.3 V / 2 A
design_gotchas.detail: The D-suffix SOIC-8 package has no exposed thermal pad (RθJA = 116.3 °C/W). Verify IC switching + conduction loss at elevated ambient temperatures and use wide copper pours on VIN, GND, and PH to assist heat spreading.

typical_use_cases: Pin-compatible 2 A cost-down second source for 3 A TPS54331DR SOIC-8 designs
12 V and 24 V industrial, car-audio, and CPE distributed power rails stepping down to 3.3 V or 5.0 V
Battery-powered wide-VIN systems needing 1 µA shutdown and 75 µA Eco-mode light-load Iq
Designs requiring programmable UVLO hysteresis and external soft-start ramp control
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TPS54231DR is a 3.5 V to 28 V, 2 A non-synchronous Eco-mode step-down converter in a standard 8-pin SOIC (D) package operating at 570 kHz with an 80 mΩ high-side MOSFET and 0.800 V reference. Pin-for-pin identical to the 3 A TPS54331DR with lower operating Iq (75 µA vs 110 µA typ), it offers direct footprint compatibility for 2 A-class rails. Engineers must respect the strict 6.0 V absolute maximum limit on Pin 3 (EN), include an external Schottky catch diode and Type-II COMP network, and verify peak inductor current stays below its 2.3 A minimum current limit.
